ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels and 25% low-intensity black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white field across the central and lateral lobe regions. Large, irregular black patches are concentrated at the proximal-medial region (near the notch) and along the trailing margins and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central notch with a measured interior angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serration across the entire boundary, with a notably deeper, irregular indentation on the medial-trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge transitioning into acute, upwardly curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered circular dark pixel clusters (potential barnacle attachment sites) on the interior white surfaces of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, dark vertical and diagonal linear disruptions visible on the central-white region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular notch and jagged tissue loss on the trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
